reference_strategy.generation_method: reuse the established Z-Image OpenPose workflow for cinematic keyframes, then the verified i2v first/last-frame card with node 142=0.6MP and baked LoRA node 175 strength_model=0

required_keyframes.description: 16:9 macro at wooden bedside-table height: one roasted coffee bean just beginning to roll toward the right edge; the same sleeping woman is soft and identifiable only in upper-right background; sunrise from upper left

required_keyframes.for: segment A last frame and A-to-B bridge
required_keyframes.description: 16:9 macro of brewed dark coffee surface settling inside the same white ceramic cup/brewer, thin real steam crossing sunrise; no hand, no decorative latte art
16:9 pillow-height profile close-up of the same woman with eyes softly closed, thin coffee steam in foreground, one fingertip subtly visible under blanket edge; no smile yet

16:9 clean coffee product hero: one unlabeled white ceramic cup centered in sunrise, real steam; two relaxed realistic hands remain at either side without covering cup; same woman's tiny knowing smile soft in background

shot_risk_budget.acceptance: one bean visibly stops at table edge; one valid fingertip; woman stays soft background
eyes remain closed; exactly one readable micro-tremor; no smile
grinding precedes sliding; sleeve cushions after slip; valid hands
cloth intercepts lid, then restrained recoil; no collision
grounds bloom and settle physically; no geometry/text
eyes closed, fingertip tightens after lash, almost-smile remains ambiguous
single full cup travels then drops slightly; coffee stays contained
base pauses visibly above wood, second hand catches, cup lowers onto cloth
her hand stops his first, eyes open second, his fingers relax third; cup remains foreground
single cup dominates; hands frame but do not cover; final 1.5 seconds stable

container_budget.note: MiniMax generates each 15-second container, not independent shot calls; take budget is therefore assigned by container using the highest-risk internal shots.

hard_checks: all intended cuts occur within 0.6 seconds of contract timing
no readable text, logo, UI, watermark or blue MiniMax demo artifact
same woman identity across B first/reveal/final
single cup continuity and stable coffee liquid
all visible hands have plausible five-finger anatomy and no fusion
three saves are readable and mechanically different
reveal action order is hand-stop -> eyes-open -> his-hand-relax
last 1.5 seconds are product-dominant and stable
A-to-B seam has no unrelated cached frame or empty output
qa_plan.review_method: explicit ffmpeg frame extraction and xstack/contact sheet; inspect with external vision model; task SUCCESS alone is insufficient

approval_gate.before_approval: keyframe prompts and dry-run only; no RunningHub task creation
approval_gate.after_any_script_change: reset both contracts to pending and require renewed approval
